criteria.label: Abnahme: alle Anforderungen aus dem Auftragstext erfüllt
criteria.detail: fehlt: Implement the OmniMetric-Engine as a production‑ready system in the designated workspace., Provide an ingestion API built with FastAPI (Python 3.11+, Pydantic v2) that returns an immediate acknowledgment for each request., Use a deterministic per‑metric ring buffer / bounded deque with O(1) memory per stream, supporting either a fixed number of data points or a 60‑second sliding window and automatically evicting old points., Compute on‑the‑fly rolling aggregations (min, max, mean, standard deviation, p50, p95, p99) for each metric’s current window., Detect outlier anomalies via Z‑Score > 3 and dynamic thresholding, with thresholds configurable per metric through a REST API., Detect trend/drift anomalies using moving‑average analysis, also configurable per metric via the REST API., Emit an alert event for each detected anomaly and enforce a configurable cooldown/deduplication window per metric to prevent identical alerts within that period., Expose a `GET /api/v1/alerts` endpoint that supports filtering by status (Active, Resolved, Silenced) and severity (Warning, Critical)., Deliver a complete pytest suite covering percentile/std‑dev correctness, ring‑buffer eviction limits, deterministic spike‑alert triggering, cooldown deduplication, and concurrent ingestion without race conditions., Include a README.md with a mathematical description of the anomaly detection, a Mermaid architecture diagram, and example benchmark requests; the system must run entirely offline without external databases or APIs.
